verdict.rationale: The open-source Orama JS library lets an agent do the whole loop in code with no dashboard: create a database with a schema, insert documents (`insert`/`insertMultiple`), and run full-text, vector or hybrid searches. Orama Cloud adds an official MCP server per project and official JS/Python/Rust SDKs, but the cited docs only show these for interacting with and searching existing data. Missing for 10: any CLI; documented API- or MCP-driven creation of Cloud projects and data sources (each project's MCP server is auto-configured, implying a project must already exist); a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404); independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven end-to-end flow.
